name: BookingSmsExtraPhone
description: EasyBook — the extra phone (SPEC_ECRANE_SMS §6): "Conectează alt telefon" when the phone included in the plan is already connected opens the existing UpgradeDialog with one add-on option, "Un telefon în plus". Only when the person acts — no proactive recommendation in the MVP. Built only from UpgradeDialog (options, confirm, processing, success, error; member variant with "Recomandă"), Sheet, SheetSection, Button and the §1 phone rows.
